claim: One fisher at one Fishing Dock position caught 0, 1 or 2 Meat per cast: over 20 casts, four 0s, five 1s and eleven 2s, 27 Meat in all (1.35 a cast). A 2 can only come from the stored 0–2 spot, so this is that spot; the two 0–1 spots were not tested.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commit 82e7c7ec), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, entry "Fishing Dock — 20 observed casts at the first occupied position", and issue 10 comment 6449620236. Cast log gameplay-evidence/fishing/first-position-20-casts.csv; contact sheets casts-01-10-contact and casts-11-20-contact; screenshots in gameplay-evidence/fishing/.

notes: Trade sandbox, Evergreen, days 33–37 at fast speed with pauses; Violet the only worker, nothing else making or using Meat. Each cast was followed to the dock's Meat count; an empty cast shows the count unchanged into the next cast. One cast across a pause was left out, so these are 20 reviewed casts, not 20 in a row. The 1.35 average is above the 1 the building page assumes for a 0–2 roll; 20 casts are too few to say whether the roll favours 2. No catches per day: the run was at fast speed. The field guide card (0–2 Meat, 18 Planks, 3 workers) matches the decoded data and the 26 Oct card.
